name: agent-harness-kit-claude
description: Claude Code edition of the agent harness: adds Claude Code-only features (agent effort, mods, eval suites) on top of agent-harness-kit.

feature_budget_usd.title: Budget per feature (USD)
feature_budget_usd.description: Dollars one feature may cost in an unattended run before the run is asked to stop after it, from Claude Code's own cost figure (subagents included). 0 = no limit.

run_budget_usd.title: Budget per run (USD)
run_budget_usd.description: Dollars a whole unattended run may cost before it is asked to stop after the current feature. 0 = no limit.

session_budget_tokens.title: Session budget (context tokens)
session_budget_tokens.description: A builder's context size at which the status line says to wrap up (shown from 80 percent). The protocol makes the builder commit, note a resume point and end blocked with session budget. 0 = no notice.

supervisor.title: Done-check supervisor
supervisor.description: After a builder's SESSION line, check the session against the feature's verify with a cheap model call. Never judges parallel lanes.

route_models.title: Choose builder models
route_models.description: Start each harness builder on the model its feature's effort asks for (low haiku, medium sonnet, high opus), one tier up on retries.

model_floor.title: Lowest model
model_floor.description: The lowest model a harness builder or evaluator may start on.
